search_limit.label: Search result limit
search_limit.description: Maximum number of app search results (3-20).

recent_count.label: Recent files shown
recent_count.description: How many recent files the card lists (3-15).

notes_dir.label: Notes directory
notes_dir.description: Create and edit Markdown notes in this directory, autosave their text, and check off tasks or start focus timers.

motion.label: Card motion
motion.description: Light expands content immediately with brief arrow feedback, avoiding repeated scroll resizing. Soft keeps a short reveal. Off only disables card motion, not the panel animation.

hotspot_ssid.label: Hotspot name (SSID)
hotspot_ssid.description: Name broadcast by the hotspot toggle in the System card. Empty = keep the name rice-hotspot remembers (<hostname>-hotspot by default).

hotspot_password.label: Hotspot password
hotspot_password.description: At least 8 characters (WPA2). Empty = use the password rice-hotspot generated; if set it is stored in plain text in Noctalia settings and remembered by rice-hotspot for CLI use.

hotspot_band.label: Hotspot band
hotspot_band.description: 2.4GHz is the most compatible; 5GHz is faster but older devices may not see it.
